result.summary: Scope test: applies (new tenant-scoped tables repository_artifacts/artifact_versions via priv/repo/migrations, new context module Letflow.Repository). Full assessment in handoffs/WF02-REQ202-20260830/security-review-req202.md. INV-1 (tenant isolation) PASS: every Repo call in lib/letflow/repository.ex passes prefix:, tenant_id derived via TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name/1 from the resolved prefix (not caller-supplied -- create_attrs has no tenant_id key), migration entirely inside if prefix() do guard. INV-4 (secrets) PASS: no secret material in diff, grep clean. INV-6 (proof of scoping) PASS: this report is the artifact. INV-7 (no SQL interpolation) PASS: no Repo.query in new files; migration's execute/2 interpolates only the trusted, framework-resolved schema name, consistent with req195's precedent. INV-8 (no unhandled crashes) PASS: create/2 and list_versions/4 use with-chains and exhaustive case matches, no bare {:ok,_}= on fallible external calls. INV-2/INV-3/INV-5 correctly NOT-APPLICABLE (S4/S5 not started, no route/lookup-by-ID endpoint exists). Additional checks: immutability triggers match AC7 exactly (repository_artifacts BOTH UPDATE+DELETE rejected, artifact_versions UPDATE only, both trigger functions schema-qualified per-tenant, no shared public-schema function), FKs both prefix-scoped so no cross-tenant reference is structurally possible, tenant_provisioning.ex manifest registration correct and complete (tuple shape matches existing entries), repository_artifacts stores only content_hash/content_type/byte_size (no raw-content column, matches design 2.1 exactly), no route/controller added (git diff --stat on lib/letflow_web and web/ is empty). promotion_digest.ex diff confirmed moduledoc-only (9 lines, all inside the existing @moduledoc heredoc, no change to canonicalize/1, compute_plan_digest/1, or verify_digest/2).

invariant_verdicts.INV-2: NOT-APPLICABLE -- S4 not started, no API response type added
invariant_verdicts.INV-5: NOT-APPLICABLE -- no lookup-by-ID HTTP endpoint exists in this diff
invariant_verdicts.INV-6: APPLIES -- PASS (this handoff + security-review-req202.md is the proof artifact)
